response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong technical depth with 20 years of engineering experience and impressive versatility across multiple domains, he significantly lacks the specialized AI expertise and strategic innovation focus central to this role. His recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq is promising but insufficient—he lacks demonstrated experience building recognized AI products or platforms, has no advanced degree in AI-related fields, and shows limited evidence of director-level strategic thinking or architectural leadership required for this AI Strategy position.
strengths: 20+ years of diverse engineering experience spanning web, mobile, embedded systems, and infrastructure, exceeding the 15-year requirement
Founder of GISCollective and strong open-source contributor demonstrating entrepreneurial initiative, technical leadership, and ability to drive independent projects
Proven ability to master multiple programming languages and rapidly adapt to different technical domains and tooling
concerns: Limited demonstrated expertise in AI/ML; only recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq without evidence of building recognized AI products or strategic AI platforms
No advanced degree in AI-related field; background emphasizes implementation and full-stack development rather than AI strategy or innovation
Unclear evidence of director-level strategic thinking, large-scale architectural decisions, or ability to guide organizational AI direction and innovation
